scope: Static structure, source coverage, internal consistency, and maintenance contract only

checks.evidence: A plain-language one-page explanation, five beginner questions, and concrete folder metaphors are present.
The artifact targets Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex Agent Skills and explicitly rejects GPT Builder outputs.
Logical versus physical modules, owner_namespace, split and merge gates, owner_collision, and inheritance are covered.
FAST, STANDARD, DEEP, R0-R3 evidence depth, quality floor, baseline comparison, and budget stop rules are covered.
Static, installation, discovery, runtime, verified, and cross-platform states are separate.
180-day principle review, 30-day platform review, event-driven source reanalysis, and local ownership updates are defined.

critic_findings.finding: The source corpus mixes reusable design principles with GPT Builder-specific packaging and release mechanics.
critic_findings.resolution: Preserve principle logic but reject GPT chatbot packaging as an Agent Skill output.

critic_findings.finding: Static structure can be mistaken for runtime or cross-platform success.
critic_findings.resolution: Use an explicit evidence ladder and prohibit status inheritance.

critic_findings.finding: A large bible can duplicate operational references and create owner collisions.
critic_findings.resolution: The bible owns constitutional principles; specialized references own executable procedures.

critic_findings.finding: Platform paths and fields age faster than architectural principles.
critic_findings.resolution: Apply separate freshness windows and reverify official sources before installation.
